theorems.name: Submission.cmr_tdn_ball_average_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (ν : Measure X) (q : X → Euclid n) (h : X → ℝ) (Λ : ℝ) (a : Euclid n → ℝ) (r : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasure ν → Measurable q → Integrable h ν → 0 ≤ Λ → Continuous a → HasCompactSupport a → (∀ y, 0 ≤ a y) → (∀ y, a y ≤ 1) → (∀ z : Euclid n, |∫ x, h x * (a (q x + z) - a (q x)) ∂ν| ≤ Λ * ‖z‖) → 0 < r → |∫ x, h x * a (q x) ∂ν| ≤ r * Λ + (volume (ball (0 : Euclid n) r)).toReal⁻¹ * (∫ x, |h x| ∂ν) * ∫ y, a y
